trade_nsqf_body: The National Skills Qualifications Framework (NSQF) is India's national credit framework. Each level represents a step up in skills. Level 4 is the entry for most ITI trades. You can move up through further training or education. Higher NSQF levels open doors to supervisory and degree-entry roles.
trade_state_fallback: No district data found. Showing state-level data.
compare_pick_prompt: Pick both trades above to see side-by-side data.
calc_subtitle: 3-year illustrative earnings: vocational route vs continuing general studies
calc_general_pay: Monthly pay if continuing general studies (Rs)
calc_formula: Formula: Vocational earnings = Starting pay x (36 - Duration) - Course cost. General earnings = General monthly pay x 36.
calc_disclaimer: Illustrative estimate from demonstration data and your inputs. Not a financial guarantee.
